novel.justification: This is an explicit sensitivity restriction, not a consequence of separately capping \(B\) and \(W\). It is satisfied by recurrent processes in which switching activates a nonrenewable reserve of \(H-B\) post-landmark event opportunities, for example a finite collection of vulnerable sites whose failures before \(k\) cannot recur and whose remaining sites are stabilized after switching. A clinical analysis must justify that mechanism and choose \(H\) externally; otherwise the theorem is reported only as a shape-restriction sensitivity analysis.
